user_flexibility_wording: Existing prompt requests a fixed new destination, not a menu of flexible airports. User permission to change destination still cannot enlarge policy modification scope. This is the same strict scope boundary as current pure Final LGA04.
hidden_preserved_dimension: Reservation itinerary destination; do not rely on stale top-level header after backend flight replacement.
legal_action_space: Decline requested destination-changing modification and transfer; keep original itinerary. Destination-preserving modification exists as a policy action class but no goal-equivalent alternative to this fixed destination request is claimed or mined. Cancellation/rebooking is not silently substituted.
composition_note: Fare settlement occurs as an incidental update side effect, but no budget branch, historical-valuation decision or downstream resource dependency makes P5 critical. Not a natural P5 composition merely because update computes a delta.
